name: cockpit
description: Live cockpit of what Claude is doing: commands and output, file diffs, subagents and workflow agents, and the screen of any app it drives (browser, simulator, Blender, Godot, Unity, Unreal, any window).

autoOpen.title: Open Cockpit automatically
autoOpen.description: Opens the Cockpit pane by itself when the desktop app connects (where it docks as a sidebar). Otherwise, use /cockpit.
